data.name: Kyton Shield
data.description: Whether in your hand or draped around your body, the spiked chain serves as both weapon and shield. When using Kyton Style, you gain a +1 shield bonus to your Armor Class as long as you are wielding a spiked chain. If the spiked chain is magical, add 1/2 its enhancement bonus to this shield bonus. If the spiked chain has the vicious ability, instead add its full enhancement bonus to the shield bonus.
